too-many-tokens: Kuzanywe ama-access token amaningi kakhulu angasebenzi kuleli kheli. Sicela ulinde imizuzu embalwa bese uzama futhi.
too-many-shared-views: Kuvulwe amaresiphi abelwana ngawo amaningi kakhulu kuleli kheli. Sicela ulinde imizuzu embalwa bese uzama futhi.
too-many-deletes: Le access token ihambise amarekhodi amaningi kakhulu kudoti ehoreni elidlule. Sicela uzame futhi emuva kwesikhathi.
too-many-changes: Kwenziwe izinguquko eziningi kakhulu kule akhawunti ngama-access token. Sicela ulinde isikhashana bese uzama futhi; izinguquko kuwebhusayithi zisasebenza.
too-many-mcp: Izicelo eziningi kakhulu kumathuluzi e-Glazecalc abasizi be-AI. Sicela ulinde imizuzu embalwa bese uzama futhi.
too-many-oauth: Izicelo eziningi kakhulu zokuxhuma izinhlelo ezivela kuleli kheli. Sicela ulinde imizuzu embalwa bese uzama futhi.
too-many-registrations: Izinhlelo eziningi kakhulu zizibhalise zona. Sicela uzame futhi emuva kwesikhathi.
too-many-imports: Kube nokungenisa okuningi kakhulu kule akhawunti ehoreni elidlule. Sicela uzame futhi emuva kwesikhathi.
